title: An ideal-sum inclusion for a module with reduced irreducible support
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Noetherian means locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth], quasi-compact, and quasi-separated; the last two conditions mean that every open cover has a finite subcover and the diagonal is quasi-compact on scheme tests. Modules are on the small etale ringed site, with quasi-coherence as in [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. On a locally Noetherian space, coherent means quasi-coherent with coherent pullbacks on all etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $\operatorname{Supp}(M)$ for the locus of nonzero geometric stalks, with the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. A closed immersion is representable and a closed immersion after every scheme base change [def-weil-closed-immersion]; reduced means that etale scheme charts have local rings without nonzero nilpotents, and irreducible means nonempty and not the union of two proper closed subsets. Assume $X$ is Noetherian. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a reduced closed subspace with $|Z|$ nonempty and irreducible, and let $F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. Put $J=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$. Suppose that $JF=0$ and $\operatorname{Supp}(F)=|i|(|Z|)$; $JF$ is the submodule generated by local products. Then there exist an integer $r\geq1$, a nonzero coherent ideal $K\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(K)=|Z|$, and an injective module morphism $$\alpha:i_*(K^{\oplus r})\longrightarrow F$$ whose cokernel $Q$ is coherent and satisfies $$\operatorname{Supp}(Q)\subsetneq |i|(|Z|).$$ Here $K^{\oplus r}$ is the finite direct sum of $r$ copies, direct image is [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], and the cokernel is taken in module sheaves.

source.place: Tag 07UQ, lemma-prepare-filter-irreducible, statement and proof, expressed by annihilation and full support using Tag 08AM, lemma-i-star-equivalence. Coherence of the direct image and cokernel: Tags 07UH and 07UC.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-closed-coherent-modules], Z is Noetherian. By [lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules], J is quasi-coherent and JF=0 gives a quasi-coherent module G on Z with i_*G≅F. This G is coherent. Let V=Spec R→X be an affine etale chart and Z_V=Z×_XV; it is a closed subscheme of V, hence Z_V=Spec R' with R→R' surjective, and an etale scheme chart of Z. The charts Z_V for all such V jointly cover Z, so their disjoint union is one surjective etale scheme chart of Z. The restriction comparison [lem-trf-space-etale-module-pushforward-restriction] identifies G(Z_V) with (i_*G)(V)≅F(V), R acting through R→R'. The pullback of F to V is coherent, hence quasi-coherent of finite type by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]; under [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence] F is thus of finite type on the etale site near V, and [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus] makes F(V) a finitely generated R-module. Hence G(Z_V) is finitely generated over R'. By [lem-sfb-space-qcoh-affine-chart-calculus], testing on the surjective chart ⊔Z_V (where G is the module associated to these sections), G is of finite type, so G(W) is finitely generated on every affine etale chart W of Z. Every etale scheme chart of Z is locally Noetherian, and the pullback of G to it is quasi-coherent and locally on affine opens W of finite type, so it is coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. The support formula in [lem-sfb-space-closed-coherent-modules] gives |i|(Supp G)=Supp F=|i|(|Z|); injectivity of the closed immersion on point spaces gives Supp G=|Z|.

source.place: Tags 08AM (lemma-i-star-equivalence), 07UH (lemma-finite-pushforward-coherent); finite-type test on an etale chart: spaces-properties.tex Tag 03M1 (lemma-properties-quasi-coherent); coherent = finite type on locally Noetherian schemes: coherent.tex Tag 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-generic-freeness] to the reduced irreducible Noetherian space Z and its full-support coherent module G. Obtain a nonempty open U⊆Z, r≥1 and an isomorphism θ:O_U^{⊕r}→G|_U. The open U is dense, since a nonempty open in an irreducible space meets every other nonempty open.

Apply [lem-sfb-space-reduced-closed-support] to |Z|∖|U| and let I be the kernel of the structure map of this closed subspace, using [lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules]. It is a quasi-coherent ideal and its unit locus is U: on an affine chart the kernel is the defining ideal, whose localization is the unit ideal exactly off the closed subscheme. The structure module is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support], and its r-fold sum E=O_Z^{⊕r} is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian]. By [lem-sfb-space-homs-over-open] applied to F=G, G=E and the ideal I, θ extends to β:I^nE→G for some n≥0.

source.place: Tag 07UM (lemma-homs-over-open), surjectivity; Tag 07UQ, construction of I and extension.

proof.text: Set K=I^n, including K=O_Z when n=0. On scheme charts use [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and transport by [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence]: the affine ideal powers localize compatibly, so these quasi-coherent ideals glue to the product-defined I^n on Z. By [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support], the quasi-coherent submodule K of the coherent O_Z is coherent and has closed support. Since K|_U=O_U, its support contains dense U and hence is all of |Z|; U is nonempty, so K≠0. Finally I^nE=K^{⊕r}: in each coordinate both submodules are precisely the local sums of products of n elements of I with one scalar. Thus β has source K^{⊕r} and restricts to θ.

source.place: Tag 07UQ, equality I^n(O_X^{⊕r})=(I^n)^{⊕r}; Tags 07UD and 07TZ for coherent closed support.

proof.text: To prove β injective, take an affine etale chart W→Z. By [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus], its point map is open and the inverse image W_U is open dense in W: every nonempty open in W has nonempty open image in irreducible |Z|, and this image meets U. W is reduced and Noetherian by the hypotheses on Z. Hence W_U→W is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (opens in a Noetherian scheme are quasi-compact). Apply [lemma-nagata-reduced-dense-image-schematic] to get SIm(W_U→W)=W. The kernel description in [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image] says exactly that O_W→j_*O_{W_U} is injective. A local section of ker(β|_W) is a tuple of sections of K|_W⊆O_W, each zero on W_U since θ is an isomorphism. The displayed injection makes every coordinate zero. The scheme/etale comparison [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence] identifies these sections on open subschemes; charts cover the small etale site. Thus ker β=0.

source.place: Tag 07UQ, final injectivity argument; morphisms.tex Tag 056D (lemma-reduced-scheme-theoretically-dense).

proof.text: The source K^{⊕r} is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian], as is C=coker β. Its support is closed by [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support], applied to the coherent module C and its zero submodule. On U the map β equals θ, so C|_U=0. Therefore Supp C⊆|Z|∖|U|⊊|Z|.

Apply the exact functor i_* on quasi-coherent modules from [lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules] to 0→K^{⊕r}→G→C→0. Composing i_*β with i_*G≅F yields the required injection α. Exactness identifies its cokernel Q with i_*C. By [lem-sfb-space-closed-coherent-modules], Q is coherent and Supp Q=|i|(Supp C)⊊|i|(|Z|), since |i| is injective and Supp C is proper. The chosen r and K already have all the required properties.
